subject: Backfill merged flags on historical task nodes
description: Context: the orchestrator daemon (/Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator, runs on http://localhost:8787) now persists merged:true + merge_sha on a task's overlay git record when /git/merge succeeds, and GET /costflow uses merged nodes as attribution sinks. Problem: all merges BEFORE this change (2026-06-10) are unstamped, so /costflow currently reports zero productive tokens (results:[] — everything shows as waste). Backfill: in the repo /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator, list branches already merged into main (git branch --merged main | grep 'orch/attempt/') and also parse merge-commit subjects on main (git log --merges --pretty='%H %s' — subjects look like "orch: merge attempt <slugified-task-key>" or "Merge orch/attempt/<slug>: ..."). Map each slug back to its task key (slug = task key with '/' replaced by '-') and stamp the overlay: the per-workspace overlay JSON lives under /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/overlay/ — for the matching workspace file, set git[key] = {...existing, merged:true, merge_sha:<commit>, merged_at:<commit date>} for each backfilled key (write the file while the daemon is stopped, or POST the equivalent through an existing daemon write route if one exists; the daemon holds the overlay in memory and saves over external edits). Same for attempts merged in other tracked repos if discoverable. Verify afterward: GET localhost:8787/costflow shows non-empty results[] and productive > 0 with conservation intact (productive + trapped == total).
